content:
Last week, Sonos announced several upcoming new features, and the first batch of upgrades has officially arrived via the "Sonos 27" app update. Here are the details.

Below are the new and upcoming features in what Sonos calls the "Sonos 27" software

Following the naming convention of iOS 27, Sonos has also named its software platform "Sonos 27".

Sonos 27 is officially launching today through a new app update on the App Store. Wondering how to know if your hardware is supported? Sonos says it works with "all Sonos S2 products," though feature availability will vary by product.

Here are the features Sonos has announced are now available:

  • Portable Surround Sound: "Two identical Sonos portable speakers (Move 2 or Sonos Play) can pair with a compatible soundbar to act as rear surround speakers, and automatically resume their original role after being moved, allowing existing hardware to serve more purposes without additional home theater setup."
  • New Sonos 27 App Navigation: "A redesigned app with cleaner navigation, swipe gestures, and pinned rooms at the top for quick control."
  • Headphone Connection (Early Testing): "Ace Ultra headphones can connect to your Sonos system, allowing users to push or pull audio from nearby speakers to the headphones without going through a phone."
  • Sonos 27 mcp (Early Testing): "Connect AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude to Sonos, giving users more choices and avoiding locking them into a single assistant."

Sonos also highlighted two other upcoming features:

  • Sonos 27 voice (Coming later this fall): "Sonos's own music-centric assistant, emphasizing that the home shouldn't be dominated by a single AI, and built with consumer choice at its core."
  • Sonos Custom Agents (2027): "Allows users to build their own agents within the system, with each agent able to have its own model, personality, and voice."

Sonos's major app redesign a few years ago sparked considerable controversy. This time around, the navigation changes are noticeably smaller, hopefully avoiding any further uproar.

What are your thoughts on the changes in the Sonos 27 app? Let us know in the comments.
